0022600225.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, 6-1 at home, 2-2 on the road) are on an eight-game winning streak and sit 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, while the Houston Rockets (8-3) are on a one-game winning streak, 7-3 in their last 10, and 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Brandon Williams (hamstring) and Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), with Oscar Tshiebwe (illness) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-2 to Houston, most recently falling 117-116 in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
